facts.value: ASU has several aptitude requirements for admission, and one requirement that may be considered is your grades. Some programs require even higher grades than the university does, making meeting grade requirements an important factor in being admitted.

Good grades are important for admission to Barrett, The Honors College. Though Barrett doesn’t require a minimum GPA, it takes your grades into account as a major factor in deciding on honors college admission.
There is no specific number of colleges you should apply to; it varies by student. It is recommended to apply to more than one college for options if not admitted to your top choice.
The number of colleges you apply to could be limited by cost as most colleges require an application fee.
Most students take the ACT or SAT in the spring of their junior year, summer after their junior year, or fall of their senior year.
Students should consider taking the PSAT in October of their junior year to be considered for National Merit and National Recognition Scholarship programs.
